data.name: DashboardSubtitle
data.value: Notice how you feel. Find a little room to breathe. This space is yours.

data.name: HeroBody
data.value: There is no right answer. A short check-in can help you reflect on your own experience.

data.name: DistributionDescription
data.value: Number of check-ins for each response. No check-ins does not mean neutral.

data.name: AverageExplanation
data.value: Average = the sum of your recorded mood scores divided by the number of check-ins. Missing responses are excluded. Small samples do not establish a trend; this is not a medical assessment.

data.name: PulseTitle
data.value: How are you feeling right now?

data.name: PulseSubtitle
data.value: Choose the response that feels closest. Add context only if you want to.

data.name: MoodChoices
data.value: Choose a mood. Use arrow keys to move between responses.

data.name: StressLabel
data.value: How much stress are you feeling?

data.name: EnergyLabel
data.value: How much energy do you have?

data.name: FactorsTitle
data.value: What might be influencing your feeling?

data.name: FactorsHint
data.value: Select any that apply, or leave this blank. "Prefer not to say" clears other factors.

data.name: SavedLocallyHint
data.value: Saved only on this device, protected for your Windows account. You can delete it at any time.

data.name: PulseSaved
data.value: Your check-in was saved locally. Thank you for taking a moment.

data.name: Skipped
data.value: Check-in skipped. No response was recorded.

data.name: WelcomeBody
data.value: Before recording: RUOK protects entries using your Windows account. The default retention is 365 days, with deletion available at any time in Settings. There is no account, telemetry or sharing. Reminders are off until you enable them. Optional activity-aware reminders check idle duration only, without recording activity. RUOK is not a medical device and does not diagnose conditions.

data.name: PrivacyAccepted
data.value: Local check-ins are enabled. Nothing is shared.

data.name: HistorySubtitle
data.value: Review your responses, not a scorecard. Select an entry to remove it.

data.name: TimeZoneCaption
data.value: Displayed dates and date filters use: {0}

data.name: InvalidDateRange
data.value: Choose a first and last day, with the first day no later than the last. The displayed range has not changed.

data.name: HistoryEmpty
data.value: No check-ins in this range. There is nothing to catch up on.

data.name: HistoryList
data.value: Recorded check-ins. Use arrow keys to select an entry.

data.name: DeleteEntryConfirm
data.value: This removes the selected check-in from RUOK. This cannot be undone. Existing exports and external backups are not changed.

data.name: DeleteRangeConfirm
data.value: Remove {0} check-ins in "{1}"? This cannot be undone. Existing exports and external backups are not changed.

data.name: Deleted
data.value: The selected local data was deleted.

data.name: ExportConfirm
data.value: Export {0} displayed entries to an unencrypted CSV file? The file includes timestamps, feelings, stress, energy, and factors, but no notes or Windows account identifiers. Other people or cloud-sync software may access the location you choose. Share only if you intend to.

data.name: Exported
data.value: Exported {0} entries. The CSV is not encrypted; keep it somewhere private.

data.name: BreathingSubtitle
data.value: A gentle breathing break, at your pace. No breath holds are required.

data.name: NebulaUnavailable
data.value: The nebula visual could not be loaded. Use the breathing phase text below; your exercise controls are still available.

data.name: BreathingSafety
data.value: Breathe comfortably, not forcefully. Stop immediately if you feel uncomfortable, dizzy, or unwell. This exercise is not treatment or a replacement for professional care.

data.name: PacingHint
data.value: Use 2 to 20 seconds per phase. Adjust before starting. It is always okay to stop.

data.name: ExercisePrivacy
data.value: This exercise does not record data. Leaving this page or switching away from RUOK pauses it. Audio and vibration are not enabled in this version.

data.name: SettingsSubtitle
data.value: Your preferences stay on this device. Nothing here enables monitoring or sharing.

data.name: AppearanceAutoSaveHint
data.value: Appearance and reduced-motion changes apply immediately and save automatically. No restart or Apply button is needed.

data.name: ReducedMotionHint
data.value: Stops both the nebula's ambient motion and breathing-size animation. Phase text and timers remain available. Windows reduced-motion and high-contrast preferences are respected.

data.name: RetentionHint
data.value: Old entries are removed when RUOK opens or refreshes, not by a background service. A shorter retention period may permanently remove existing entries.

data.name: NotificationsIntro
data.value: Optional reminders appear in the normal Windows notification area. Windows controls their placement, spacing, sound and visibility, including Do Not Disturb. Nothing is recorded when you dismiss or skip.

data.name: ActivityPrivacy
data.value: Auto mode checks only time since your last input in this Windows session. It waits while you are idle for 5 minutes or more, then gives you 2 minutes after returning before a due reminder. No keys, mouse positions, app names, window titles or activity history are collected or stored.

data.name: NotificationLayoutFaces
data.value: Five faces - very low to great

data.name: NotificationLayoutSurveyAndSkip
data.value: Take the survey / Skip for now

data.name: FaceActionLabel
data.value: When I click a notification face

data.name: FaceActionOpenPulseCheck
data.value: Open PulseCheck with the face selected

data.name: KeepInTrayLabel
data.value: Keep reminders running in the system tray when I close the window

data.name: ReminderBackgroundHint
data.value: While reminders are enabled, Close can hide RUOK in the tray. Open it again or choose Quit from its tray menu. Quit stops reminders. RUOK does not start at Windows sign-in or wake the PC. After sleep, only one overdue reminder is considered, within your allowed window. An overnight window belongs to the day it starts.

data.name: RemindersSaved
data.value: Reminder settings saved. Enabling or changing the schedule starts a fresh interval. Previous RUOK notifications were cleared.

data.name: ReminderScheduleHint
data.value: Configured for every {0} minutes within {1}-{2}, subject to your selected days and mode. A recorded check-in postpones the next reminder.

data.name: NotificationReady
data.value: Windows notifications are enabled for RUOK.

data.name: NotificationBlocked
data.value: Windows has disabled RUOK notifications. Check Windows Settings > System > Notifications. RUOK will not override that setting.

data.name: NotificationUnavailable
data.value: Native notification registration is unavailable. Local check-ins still work.

data.name: NotificationRegistrationError
data.value: Windows could not register RUOK notifications ({0}). Run RUOK normally, not as administrator, and check the app's development/package registration.

data.name: NotificationSendError
data.value: Windows could not accept the notification ({0}). No delivery is assumed.

data.name: NotificationNotAccepted
data.value: Windows did not accept the notification. Run RUOK without elevation and check Windows notification settings.

data.name: ActivityUnavailable
data.value: Windows idle information is unavailable. Auto reminders are paused; choose timed reminders or try again later.

data.name: NotificationSaveBody
data.value: Take a moment for yourself. Click a face to save that mood locally, or dismiss to skip.

data.name: NotificationOpenBody
data.value: Click a face to open PulseCheck with your choice selected. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

data.name: NotificationSurveyBody
data.value: A short check-in, only if you want to. Skipping does not record a response.

data.name: TestNotificationHint
data.value: Uses your saved button layout. Clicking a test face only previews the selection in PulseCheck; it never saves a check-in automatically. Check Notification Center if Do Not Disturb hides the banner.

data.name: NotificationTestBody
data.value: This is a test. Click a face or button to try it; no check-in will be saved automatically.

data.name: TestNotificationSent
data.value: Windows accepted the test notification. Its banner may be suppressed by Windows settings or Do Not Disturb. No check-in was saved.

data.name: TestNotificationReceived
data.value: Test notification received. This is a preview only; no check-in was saved. Use Skip to clear the preview.

data.name: TestNotificationSkipped
data.value: Test notification skipped. No check-in was saved.

data.name: NotificationExpired
data.value: This reminder has expired. No response was saved; you can start a new check-in.

data.name: NotificationInvalid
data.value: RUOK could not validate this notification action. No check-in was saved.

data.name: NotificationNeedsConsent
data.value: Review and acknowledge the privacy information before recording. The notification did not save a check-in.

data.name: NotificationDisabled
data.value: Reminders have been turned off. This earlier notification did not save a check-in.

data.name: NotificationAlreadySaved
data.value: This reminder already recorded a check-in. No duplicate was added.

data.name: NotificationDraft
data.value: Review your check-in and save when ready. Your notification selection has not been recorded yet.

data.name: TrayTooltip
data.value: RUOK - reminders running. Right-click to open or quit.

data.name: TrayUnavailable
data.value: RUOK could not create or use its tray icon. The window will stay accessible; reopen RUOK if needed.

data.name: RetentionConfirm
data.value: Entries older than {0} days will be removed from RUOK now and on future refreshes. This cannot be undone.

data.name: RetentionRemoved
data.value: Removed {0} entries under your retention preference.

data.name: DataProtection
data.value: Your wellbeing values and settings are protected using Windows DPAPI for your user account. The database file still exposes its structure and row count. Encryption does not protect against malware running as you or a privileged administrator.

data.name: DataRecovery
data.value: Losing your Windows profile can make entries unrecoverable. CSV export is available in History. Portable backup/restore is not included yet. Deletion does not erase existing exports, OS backups, or forensic disk traces.

data.name: NoMonitoring
data.value: No telemetry, manager access, online account or activity history. Optional Auto mode checks idle duration only, in memory. Reminders require opt-in. Sign-in startup is not registered.

data.name: ResetConfirm
data.value: Delete every local check-in, turn reminders off, clear RUOK notifications, and reset appearance, retention and privacy acknowledgement? This cannot be undone. Export first if you need a copy. External exports and backups will not be deleted.

data.name: ResetDone
data.value: Your local check-ins and preferences were removed. Local recording is disabled until you acknowledge the privacy information again.

data.name: AboutTitle
data.value: A space for reflection, not diagnosis

data.name: Disclaimer
data.value: RUOK is not a medical device. It does not diagnose conditions and is not a replacement for professional care. Personal summaries can be incomplete or inaccurate. A mood score alone does not establish an emergency or a health condition.

data.name: ResourceBody
data.value: If you would like support, consider speaking with someone you trust or a qualified professional. You can also find your employer's employee-assistance contact, if available. If you need immediate help, use your local emergency services. RUOK never contacts anyone automatically.

data.name: PhaseNotice
data.value: Phase 3 preview: local PulseChecks, history, CSV export, breathing and opt-in native reminders. Detailed reflections, scheduled appearance, additional exercises, sign-in startup and portable backups are future milestones. There is no employee-monitoring or team-reporting module.

data.name: ResourceDeferred
data.value: Configurable local resource contacts will be added in a later milestone. No unverified regional phone numbers are supplied.

data.name: Cancelled
data.value: Cancelled. No requested changes were made.

data.name: StorageError
data.value: RUOK could not safely read or save local data. Check available disk space, file access, and your Windows profile, then use Refresh. Displayed history may be out of date. No automatic reset or plaintext fallback was performed.

data.name: FileError
data.value: The file or Windows dialog could not be accessed. Check permissions, free space, and whether the file is in use, then try again. No export success is assumed.

data.name: ValidationError
data.value: Check your selections and acknowledge the privacy information before recording. If the problem continues, refresh local data.
